info.description: Backend for the Bakingholic operator and administrator applications. Authenticate with an RS256 bearer token. WebSocket clients first request a one-use ticket from `POST /auth/ws-token`; the WebSocket protocol is documented in the project API guide because OpenAPI does not describe it.
info.summary: Order fulfillment, warehouse inventory, and Shopee synchronization API.
